history.value: Format v2: rule-builder results table can never show live rich-field data; rootUrl-less custom connectors can't self-heal on refresh

history.text:
Found while converting tests to the new format-v2 JSONL shape (tracker issue 3212e2ff). Two separate, architecturally-deep gaps, both left as deliberate KNOWN GAP markers in the test suite rather than papered over:

1) Rule-builder preview can't show rich external fields. rulePreview (src/wigwag-app.js) evaluates a bound rule via buildSource directly, with no live-fetch mechanism of its own. Under format v2, buildSource's github/jira/salesforce slots only ever read whatever's directly on the persisted ref -- which is always trimmed to {href} now (sourceRefHasFullData is unconditionally false for any non-wigwag ref by design, see FORMAT_V2.md). So a rule referencing source.github.labels (or .status, .assignee, etc) will ALWAYS show as empty/no-match in the live results table, for every row, no matter how recently it was refreshed -- the real fetched payload only ever reaches applyLiveLinkedRules at refresh time, in memory, and is never cached anywhere buildSource can read it back from. Confirmed via tests/bound-value-panel.spec.js (several tests had to be rewritten to stop relying on the preview showing a real label match). The FINAL APPLIED cell value still works correctly after an explicit refresh -- it's specifically the authoring-time preview that can't reflect it. Possible fix: have the preview perform (or reuse a cached result of) a real fetch per linked row when the rule being edited references a rich field, rather than reading buildSource's thin snapshot -- a real product decision, not a one-line patch.

2) A custom (macro) connector with no rootUrl can't be re-identified by href alone on refresh. resolveRefSystem's kind-less-connector branch host-matches an href against each candidate's own rootUrl -- but a macro connector's rootUrl is optional (its patterns are the primary identification mechanism, matched against the ORIGINALLY PASTED text, not the href). So once a ref only has {title, href} persisted (e.g. a Linear macro returning a real url), and that connector has no rootUrl set, liveFetchedViaForRef/matchedIdFromHref/resolveRefreshDispatch can never re-find it on refresh -- refreshField silently no-ops. Confirmed via tests/bound-value-panel.spec.js's custom-connector subject-group test. Possible fix: teach matchedIdFromHref to also try a kind-less connector's own patterns as a substring search against the href (not just the anchored full-string match used for the originally-pasted text) when host-matching fails.

Both are left as commented-out assertions with KNOWN GAP comments in tests/bound-value-panel.spec.js so the suite stays green without hiding the gap.
